title: docs(adr): ADR-0142 D2 tells an empty queue expansion from a failed member read; the D6 slate and the D7 grant pass refuse a failed read
body:
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GYf6UotVbAqJPefyyEYXTF)_ Fixes #29738 Part of #29604 — step 1 of ruling B (record 6594432222), with the D6 target set by the maintainer's second ruling (record 6599731698, B). The code half stays open on the parent and is dispatched after this PR merges. domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYJgdcYRwx5iQa5Ksc Clause-②: no (ADR text only; no published accept set moves) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：只改 ADR-0142 一份文件（+61 / −3 行）。D2 新增一段，把「展开结果为空」（事实）和「读失败」（故障，含队列本身的 `sys_queue` 行、成员行和各成员表）分开，并写明谁得哪个答案：三类准入消费者（D3 访问路径、D4 认领、D5 分派池）在读失败时继续答「没人」，因为对它们来说「没人」就是拒绝；D7 共享授权重算在读失败时拒绝并保留原有授权；D6 审批人名单读失败时，审批节点拒绝打开，所有 onEmptyApprovers 策略一律如此，单独的可重试错误类并点名失败的读取。状态行加第二条 Amended 注记，引用两条裁决记录。 - 为什么改：今天队列展开器在成员表读失败时对所有消费者一律答「没人」。对访问路径这是安全的，但一条以队列为收件人的共享规则会按空集合重算、撤销它给过的全部授权；审批人名单会缩水。其他所有共享、审批收件人读取在 #29362、#29503 之后都已改为读失败即拒绝，队列是最后一个。你在 #29604 的决策卡上选了 B：先改 ADR，再改代码。 - 风险与回滚：本 PR 只有文字，不动代码、schema、changeset，运行时行为零变化。风险只在文字是否准确表达裁决。按你 09:11Z 的裁决（#29604 记录 6599731698）：读失败时审批节点拒绝打开，所有 onEmptyApprovers 策略一律如此，可重试；D6 第 2 条「字面量永不再写」原样保留，只把字面量拼写对齐为队列的机器名。回滚即 revert 本 PR；代码半边（#29604）在本 PR 合并前不派发。 - 先看：`docs/adr/0142-ownership-queue-membership-claim-and-assignment-rules.md` 一份文件，按风险：① D6 第 5 条之后新增的 Amended 段（节点拒绝打开一段，含执行点：resolveApproverSpec 的 directoryFailure、queue 分支的提前返回、openNodeRequest 在 slateNamesAPerson 之前拒绝）；② D2 新增段的两个要点（读失败清单含 `sys_queue`）；③ 第 3 行状态行末尾的新注记。 - 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` 预期只列这一份文件，`1 file changed, 61 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)`；被改的 3 行是状态行和 D6 第 2 条的两行（字面量改用队列机器名拼写）。 - 需要你做的：席位契约复核通过后（评论 6600699486，`Head-sha: 589be3056a8aefc66f6273c9d0cd060d6979d3b4`），在本 PR 上点 Approve（`docs/adr/**` 为 Tier H，需你的批准）；之后由席位落地。 ## What changes One file, `docs/adr/0142-ownership-queue-membership-claim-and-assignment-rules.md`. Text only: no code, no schema, no changeset (`skip-changeset` — `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing). - **Status line.** A second note in the first note's shape, citing ruling records 6594432222 and 6599731698 on #29604 (letter B both times): D2 tells an empty expansion (a fact) from a failed read behind the queue (a fault). The admission consumers (D3, D4, D5) keep "nobody" on a failed read. The D7 grant recompute refuses it. The D6 approver slate refuses it, and the approval node refuses to open. See the notes in D2, D6 and D7. - **D2.** A new paragraph after "An empty expansion is a fact, not a fault". An expansion is *empty* when every member specification was read and reached nobody (an unstaffed position, an emptied team, a queue with no member rows, a name that resolves nowhere). A read *fails* when any read the expansion makes cannot be done: the queue's own row (`sys_queue`, through which an authored queue resolves), the member rows (`sys_queue_member`), and the member tables a specification reads (`sys_user_position`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_business_unit_member`, the BU tree). A queue that could not be resolved is not a queue that resolves nowhere. A table absent from the composition is absence, not failure. The consumer says which answer it is owed when it calls (how is the code half's): the **admission consumers** (D3, D4, D5) keep "nobody", logged at `warn`, because for them nobody denies; the **recompute consumers** (D6, D7) refuse, as a thrown failure naming the read, never `[]`, `null` or `false`. - **D6.** A note after item 5: item 2's "expanded to nobody" is the empty case. A failed read behind the queue refuses the slate, and the approval node refuses to open under every `onEmptyApprovers` policy (`admin_rescue`, `auto_approve`, `fail`, `fallback`). It is not routed to administrators, not auto-approved, and not opened on a fallback slate. It fails loudly, with its own error class (not `NO_APPROVERS`, not "expanded to nobody"), names the failed read, and is retryable. There is no parked or auto-retry state. The ruling puts `team` and `position` approvers in the same class. Execution point: `resolveApproverSpec`'s `directoryFailure`; the queue branch's early return consults it first; `openNodeRequest` refuses before `slateNamesAPerson` hands the slate to `onEmptyApprovers`. Item 2's "never written again" stays whole, and item 2 now spells the literal by the queue's machine name (`queue:NAME`). - **D7.** A note after item 5: item 1's "an empty queue grants nothing and warns once" is the empty case. A failed read behind the queue refuses the grant pass; the rule-wide passes (`evaluateRule`, `evaluateAllForRecord`, `revokeRuleGrantsForRetiredRecipients`) and the per-user recompute (`reconcileRuleForUser`, reached from `recipient-membership-recompute.ts` through the queue's holder check) each stop that rule's pass before any revoke, keep the rule's existing grants exactly as they were, log at `warn` naming the rule and the read, and let the record's other rules reconcile — the #29362 isolation shape. A grant is re-evaluated on the rule's next pass. The membership-write look-through (`queuesNaming`) revokes nothing and is outside this amendment. Nothing else in the record moves: D1, D3, D4, D5, D8, D9, the alternatives, open items, verification notes and execution plan are untouched, apart from D6 item 2's literal spelling, aligned to the queue's machine name. D5 already says a failed read during evaluation leaves the row and warns; the D2 paragraph cites it rather than restating it. ## Why The measure the order asked for, read at `origin/main` `c76c0e04` (the branch base; the merge to `42ff86f6` moved none of these files): - **Today's expander answers nobody on a failed member read, for every consumer.** `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue-service.ts`: `expandSpec` L305–318 (catch → warn once → `[]`), `holderCheck` L394–404 (catch → warn once → `false`), `authoredMemberSpecs` L466–497 (catch → warn once, authored members count as nobody), `authoredQueueNames` L439–463 (catch → `[]`). The module header L33–39 declares that posture; ADR-0142 did not. - **Consumers by D-number.** - D3 access: `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` `callerQueues` L890–909 (`queuesOf`, catch → `[]`) and `sitsInCallersQueue` L925–952 (`isMember`); `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/kernel-queue-membership.ts` `resolveOnto` L89–113 (`queuesOf`, catch → fails closed). - D4 claim: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` L1517 (`isMember` admits a member's insert naming a queue); a claim's D3 basis is `sitsInCallersQueue` above; `security-plugin-explain-access.ts` L512 (`isMember` for the explain reason). - D5 pool: `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts` L291–301 (`expandMembers`; `[]` parks with the "no members" warning, a throw parks with "members could not be read"). - D6 slate: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` `expandQueueUsers` L3326–3331 (`expandMembers`, purpose `addressing`), called from `resolveApproverSpec` L2621–2627; the queue "expanded to nobody" branch L2674–2690; the graph types' failure class L2712–2718 → `warnExpansionFailed` L2742–2759; `holderReadRefusal` L1142. - D7 grants: `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts` `expandRecipient` queue branch L2176–2186 (`expandMembers`; feeds `evaluateRule` L1253, the per-record pass L1413–1425 with its per-rule catch, `revokeRuleGrantsForRetiredRecipients` L1573–1600) and `ruleReachesUser` L1745–1749 (`isMember`, the per-user recompute from `recipient-membership-recompute.ts` L300–323 with its per-pair catch). So a `queue` sharing recipient is diffed against a set missing its members on an outage and its grants are revoked, and a queue approver routes to a shrunk slate, while every other recipient read refuses since PR #29602 (#29503). The ruling (B, record 6594432222 on #29604) puts the ADR text first. ## Tests None: a docs-only diff. No package is touched, so no build closure (①) and no package test (②) is owed; the derived gate families (③) are under Verification. ## Acceptance notes - **The reading taken for D6.** The D6 note states the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-03 (record 6599731698 on #29604, letter B). That ruling replaced the earlier "follows #29503's class" wording after the contract review (6599389641) showed that `openNodeRequest` routes a literal-only slate through `onEmptyApprovers`. The note names the execution point for the code half; the held-literal reading is withdrawn. - **Mechanism left to the code half.** How a call says which answer it is owed (a purpose argument, which `expandMembers` already takes for `addressing`, or a refusing variant) is #29604's to choose; the record fixes who is owed which. The contract review notes that the spec's `QueueExpansionPurpose` (`access` | `addressing`) is an independent axis; refuse-vs-nobody must not overload it. - **`QUEUE_READ_LIMIT`** (silent drop past 10,000 rows, comment 6591670782 on #29604) is not an ADR matter and is not mentioned; it stays the code half's call, as the ruling record says. - Out-of-scope findings: none new. - Body shape: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`'s headings are folded into the os-dev order (What changes / Why / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification), its two declaration lines sit at the top, and its Human Minimum list follows.
